## Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Problem It Solves
Is there a problem you're trying to solve? If so, describe it. (e.g., "I wish the extension would also work when...")

## Proposed Solution
How do you think this feature should work?

## Alternative Solutions
Have you thought of any other ways to solve this problem?

## Additional Context
Any other context, use cases, or examples?
